name: Right Kidney
description: Retroperitoneal organ at T12–L3, slightly lower than the left due to the liver. On CT: assess cortical thickness, corticomedullary differentiation, collecting system dilatation (hydronephrosis), stones, masses, and renal vascular anatomy. Contrast phases: corticomedullary (30s), nephrographic (80s), excretory (3–5 min).
